change.source: Cargo.toml:25 judgement note CONFIRMED introduced: the aep-domain dev-dependency carries no comment, which aep/AGENTS.md:212 requires beside every dependency. Two rules conflict here — that line, and Timo's standing instruction that manifests carry no explanatory comments (the sub-operator removed the implementor's comment under it, so the finding is the sub-operator's doing). Settled on measurement rather than on either rule: across crates/*/*/Cargo.toml there are 33 dev-dependency entries, 7 with a comment immediately above and 26 bare, including aep-driver's own workspace-internal aep-project, aep-schema, serde_yaml and trace-spec. A bare workspace-internal dev-dependency is the repository's observed convention, so nothing is owed here and the line stays bare. The real defect is that AGENTS.md:212 does not describe 26 of 33 entries; the coordinator files that as its own draft story and carries the rule conflict in CHECKPOINT.md pending Timo's reconciliation
